name: pw-rerun-stability
notes: playwright-native/1's evidence is tree-reconstructed from `error.location` + the recorded worktree source (source_region = the matched line's text, rel_offsets = frame-line offsets relative to the test's own declaration line) instead of raw `error.snippet` (line-shift unstable -- probes/playwright-0b-core/observations/stability-report.json, line_shift.raw_snippet_identical === false). run_id is the content address of the whole record excluding only the recording group, so two runs at the *same* tree producing the same run_id is a superset proof of evidence stability (CE-2, same argument as adv-rerun-stability). `shifted` is the same test with 3 harmless comment lines inserted above the test declaration line -- the test body and failing line text are byte-for-byte unchanged, only their absolute line numbers move. If the recorder used raw error.snippet (absolute-line-gutter) this project would flip the still-failing test into `updated_fail`; because it reconstructs from source + relative offsets, `evidence_digest`/`structural_fingerprint` stay stable and the test stays in `still_fail_unchanged` (CE-3).

steps.message: shift declaration line by 3 harmless comment lines
